en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a European townscape with a large hill in the foreground. Dominating the right side is a medieval castle complex with two tall, pointed-roof towers and a central building, surrounded by trees. In the background to the left, the town of Rochlitz is visible with church spires and clustered houses. At the top left in orange lettering is the printed caption "Schloß Rochlitz i. Sa."
